articles.abstract_en: We propose an equilibrium theory of data-driven antitrust oversight in which regulators launch investigations on the basis of suspicious bidding patterns and cartels can adapt to the statistical screens used by regulators. Our main result establishes that screening for collusion using tests with a low false-positive rate (safe tests) is a robust improvement over laissez-faire. Safe tests do not create new collusive equilibria and do not hurt competitive industries. In addition, safe tests can have strict bite, including unraveling all collusive equilibria in some settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个数据驱动反垄断监管的均衡理论，其中监管机构基于可疑的投标模式展开调查，而卡特尔可以适应监管机构使用的统计筛选。我们的主要结果表明，使用低误报率（安全测试）的测试来筛选合谋，是对自由放任的稳健改进。安全测试不会创造新的合谋均衡，也不会损害竞争性行业。此外，安全测试可以具有严格的约束力，包括在某些情况下瓦解所有合谋均衡。

articles.title_en: Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: A Reassessment
articles.title_cn: 制造业的无条件收敛：一个再评估
articles.abstract_en: The movement of labor out of agriculture is a central feature of the development process. A long-held view is that successful development requires that much of the labor released from agriculture be allocated to manufacturing rather than services. Rodrik's (2013) finding of unconditional convergence for manufacturing productivity, using data from UNIDO, provided empirical support for this view. We argue that the UNIDO data are ill-suited for studying cross-country productivity dynamics. Using recently released GGDC data designed for this purpose, we revisit the issue and find no evidence of unconditional convergence in manufacturing productivity over 1990–2018.
articles.abstract_cn: 劳动力从农业转移出去是发展过程的一个核心特征。一个长期持有的观点是，成功的发展要求从农业释放出来的大部分劳动力被分配到制造业而非服务业。Rodrik（2013）利用UNIDO数据发现制造业生产率存在无条件收敛，这为上述观点提供了实证支持。我们认为UNIDO数据不适合用于研究跨国生产率动态。利用为此目的而新发布的GGDC数据，我们重新审视了这一问题，并未发现1990-2018期间制造业生产率存在无条件收敛的证据。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies Markov perfect equilibria in a repeated duopoly model where sellers choose algorithms. An algorithm is a mapping from the competitor's price to own price. Once set, the algorithms respond quickly. Customers arrive randomly, and sellers can periodically revise their algorithms. The main results are that (i) for the simple two-price model with standard profit functions, monopoly pricing is the unique equilibrium outcome and (ii) for any general finite price grid, all equilibrium outcomes feature supracompetitive pricing. Sustenance of such collusion seems outside the scope of current antitrust laws, for it does not involve any direct communication.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了卖方选择算法的重复双寡头模型中的马尔可夫完美均衡。算法是从竞争对手价格到自身价格的映射。一旦设定，算法会迅速响应。顾客随机到达，卖方可以定期修改其算法。主要结果是：（i）对于具有标准利润函数的简单两价格模型，垄断定价是唯一的均衡结果；（ii）对于任何一般的有限价格网格，所有均衡结果都表现为超竞争定价。这种合谋的维持似乎超出了当前反垄断法的范围，因为它不涉及任何直接沟通。

articles.title_en: The Missing Middle Managers: Labor Costs, Firm Structure, and Development
articles.title_cn: 缺失的中层管理者：劳动力成本、企业结构与发展
articles.abstract_en: Using data obtained from human resources consulting firms, we document the cost to large firms of hiring managers and business professionals in 146 countries worldwide. The average pay in the poorest decile of countries is $18,000 per year, which is 9.7 times GDP per worker. In contrast, in the richest decile of countries, large firms pay managers and business professionals only 0.8 times GDP per worker. We use an appropriate technology model to show that the cost of management could be an important deterrent to the expansion of the modern sector in developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用从人力资源咨询公司获得的数据，我们记录了在146个国家中，大型企业雇佣管理人员和商务专业人员的成本。最贫穷的十分位国家的平均年薪为$18,000，是人均GDP的9.7倍。相比之下，在最富有的十分位国家，大型企业支付给管理人员和商务专业人员的薪酬仅为人均GDP的0.8倍。我们使用一个适宜技术模型来表明，管理成本可能是发展中国家现代部门扩张的重要障碍。

articles.title_en: What Is Newsworthy? Theory and Evidence
articles.title_cn: 什么具有新闻价值？理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a model in which a benevolent news outlet decides whether to report the realization of a state to a consumer, who pays a cost to receive it. A simple statistical rule, called a proper scoring rule, describes when the outlet should be more likely to report the realization. Using data from the US television news, we show that a particular scoring rule successfully predicts many salient features of news reporting. We show how to use this rule as a control variable to discipline tests of reporting bias, and we show that controlling for it matters in our applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一个模型，其中一家善意的新闻媒体决定是否向消费者报告某个状态的实现情况，而消费者需要支付成本才能接收该信息。一个简单的统计规则，称为适当评分规则，描述了媒体在何种情况下更有可能报告该实现情况。利用美国电视新闻的数据，我们表明一个特定的评分规则能够成功预测新闻报道的许多显著特征。我们展示了如何将该规则作为控制变量来规范对报道偏差的检验，并表明在我们的应用中控制该变量具有重要意义。

articles.abstract_en: We develop a method for delineating prime locations—ultradense clusters of economic activity—within cities and apply it to comprehensive establishment data covering all US metropolitan areas. We further use big data to extend the analysis to a global context where administrative data are sparse. Many cities in the United States and around the world are dominated by a small number of prime locations that can concentrate up to one-half of tradable services jobs on tiny shares of land and are dominant centers of economic gravity. In cities with fewer prime locations, a larger tradable services share concentrates in them.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种方法，用于在城市内划定黄金地段——经济活动的超密集集群，并将其应用于覆盖美国所有大都市区的综合企业数据。我们进一步利用大数据将分析扩展到行政数据稀缺的全球背景。美国和世界各地的许多城市由少数黄金地段主导，这些地段可以在极小的土地份额上集中多达一半的可贸易服务工作岗位，并且是经济重力的主导中心。在黄金地段较少的城市，更大的可贸易服务份额集中于此。

articles.title_en: How Test-Optional Policies in College Admissions Disproportionately Harm High-Achieving Applicants from Disadvantaged Backgrounds
articles.title_cn: 大学录取中的可选考试政策如何不成比例地损害来自弱势背景的高成就申请者
articles.abstract_en: We analyze data from one elite institution and find that test score-optional policies harm the likelihood of admission for high-achieving applicants from disadvantaged backgrounds. Under test-optional policies, these applicants submit test scores at too low a rate; they more than double their admission probability (from 2.9 percent to 7.2 percent) by reporting scores. Our findings suggest that, more than commonly understood, elite institutions interpret test scores in the context of an applicant's background. Thus, availability of test scores on an application can promote rather than hinder social mobility.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一所精英院校的数据，发现可选考试政策损害了来自弱势背景的高成就申请者的录取可能性。在可选考试政策下，这些申请者提交考试成绩的比例过低；通过报告成绩，他们的录取概率增加了一倍以上（从2.9%到7.2%）。我们的研究结果表明，精英院校在解读考试成绩时，比通常理解得更注重申请者的背景。因此，申请中提供考试成绩可以促进而非阻碍社会流动性。

articles.title_cn: 缺失的贷款价值比周期
articles.abstract_en: We show that the equilibrium loan-to-value (LTV) distribution in the US mortgage market has been remarkably stable over the last quarter century, both in aggregate and region by region, despite large, cross-sectionally heterogeneous house price cycles. While high-LTV mortgages changed from being explicitly government backed to privately securitized and back, their overall fraction remained unchanged. A repeat-sales methodology and an analysis of loan performance confirm that this stability in the distribution of LTVs holds even within subgroups of the population. These findings are inconsistent with models of credit cycles that use changes in collateral constraints to generate boom-and-bust dynamics in house prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，美国抵押贷款市场中均衡的贷款价值比（LTV）分布在过去四分之一世纪中一直非常稳定，无论是在总体上还是按地区划分，尽管存在大规模且横截面异质的房价周期。虽然高LTV抵押贷款从明确由政府支持转变为私人证券化，再转回政府支持，但其总体比例保持不变。重复销售方法和贷款表现分析证实，即使在人口子群体内，LTV分布的稳定性也成立。这些发现与使用抵押品约束变化来生成房价繁荣-萧条动态的信贷周期模型不一致。
